info.name: Midnight Beauty
info.description: The name alone suggests that this deliciously indulgent donut makes the perfect midnight treat. But we recommend enjoying it midday, midweek, or even midsenten... With rich dark chocolate, white chocolate drizzle. (Carbohydrates: 17gm, Proteins: 6gm)

info.name: Original Sin
info.description: Some things don't need an explanation. Like this milk chocolate favourite, or the instant rush you feel when you bite it. Milk Chocolate, white chocolate drizzle. (Carbohydrates: 21gm, Proteins: 6gm)

info.name: Black & White Bavarion
info.description: Warm. Melty Gooey. Comforting. Like a hug you can eat Filled with vanilla custard, topped with dark chocolate and white chocolate drizzle (Carbohydrates: 7gm, Proteins: 7gm)

info.name: Brownie Crumble
info.description: When you want to have your cake and eat you donut too, the Brownie Crumble is the donut for you Signature cocoa donut with dark chocolate and brownie bits (Carbohydrates: 17gm, Proteins: 7gm)

info.name: Choco Bomb
info.description: Want every bite to be an explosion of gooey chocolate - We got you. Filled with milk chocolate ganache and topped with dark chocolate, strawberry drizzle (Carbohydrates: 19gm, Proteins: 7gm)

info.name: Chocolate Decadence
info.description: Find yourself living, breathing and dreaming of chocolate - Us too. Luckily we have the cure. Filled with dark chocolate ganache and dipped in dark chocolate. (Carbohydrates: 19gm, Proteins: 7gm)

info.name: Chocolate Therapy
info.description: If you believe chocolate is the answer to all of life's hard questions, look no further than Chocolate Therapy. Signature cocoa donut with dark and milk chocolate ganache. (Carbohydrates: 15gm, Proteins: 7gm)

info.name: Cinnaster
info.description: Fluffy dough meets sweet cinnamon sugar- did someone say instant favourite. With cinnamon sugar (Carbohydrates: 11gm, Proteins: 8gm)

info.name: Cookie Overload
info.description: If you're always caught with your hand in the cookie jar, we've got the donut for you With white chocolate and crumbled Oreo cookies, filled with Oreo custard (Carbohydrates: 15gm, Proteins: 7gm)

info.name: Cool Blue Ice
info.description: Step aside, chocolate. This tangy, sweet, blueberry filled treat will have chocolate lovers everywhere eyeing a new favourite. With Tangy blueberry compote and the MOD signature glaze. (Carbohydrates: 22gm, Proteins: 6gm)

info.name: Dark Knight
info.description: Armed with cookies and cream, this donut will rescue you from cravings of any kind. With white chocolate ganache, sprinkled with crushed Oreo cookies (Carbohydrates: 22gm, Proteins: 9gm)

info.name: Divine Crush
info.description: If rainbow coloured candy, mild chocolate and a dash of childhood nostalgia hit the spot, get yourself the Divine Crush With milk chocolate and colourful candy. (Carbohydrates: 21gm, Proteins: 7gm)

info.description: When the chocolates so nice, you've got to have it twice With gooey dark chocolate ganache, milk chocolate and white chocolate drizzle (Carbohydrates: 22gm, Proteins: 6gm)

info.description: Always deep diving in to the Nutella jar - We'll do you one better With Nutella custard, milk chocolate and icing sugar (Carbohydrates: 15gm, Proteins: 8gm)

info.name: Mocha Truffle
info.description: Your favourite coffee order, disguised as a donut With espresso chocolate ganache, white chocolate, milk chocolate chunks (Carbohydrates: 21gm, Proteins: 6gm)

info.description: You can't beat a classic, but you can bite into one. With MOD signature glaze (Carbohydrates: 26gm, Proteins: 7gm, Fats: 20gm)

info.description: Rumoured to be an instant mood lifter, and the secret behind many smiles, his donut has a side effect - it makes everything better. With white chocolate and coffee mousse (Carbohydrates: 25gm, Proteins: 7gm)
